provenance.transcription_basis: Photograph visibly containing the January 19, 2018 FEMA/NFIP letter.
provenance.immutable_source_note: Retain the original photograph outside the public repository; use the SHA-256 value to correlate a privately retained source artifact.

temporal_controls.note: FEMA subsequently implemented Risk Rating 2.0; policies renewing on or after April 1, 2022 became subject to the new methodology.

linked_case.purpose: Historical NFIP evidence for the LOMA/NFIP evidence layer; not a FEMA determination.

authority_sources.title: National Flood Insurance Program Record of Decision, April 2018

claim_controls: The 2018 premium is historical evidence only.
The photograph does not establish current flood zone, current premium, BFE, datum, lowest adjacent grade, or LOMA eligibility.
Do not infer historical overcharge without complete policy, rating, map, and premium evidence.
Do not infer FEMA model dependency from the historical insurance letter.

historical_policy_fields_observed.note: The source photograph contains policy-specific financial/identifier fields. Those fields are intentionally not reproduced in the public repository.
